items.title: Dave Bennett interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 16, 2025
items.q: I’m a huge Glenn Miller fan. In fact I think Glenn was on my radar before I heard Benny.

ctx.x: Me too, and “The Glenn Miller Story.” And I mean Glenn Miller’s band, the LPs is what first got my attention as a kid I think. But you know that they’re Hollywood-ized but they’re fun nonetheless.
Totally. I mean I’m a huge Glenn Miller fan. In fact I think Glenn was on my radar before I heard Benny. You know, so I love all that stuff. A lot of good memories.
And are you aware of Sol Yaged?
